acceptance_criteria.description: Address route reads only customer-owned addresses and supports selection, safe edit, and new Address creation. New Address province/city choices come only from the canonical Iran 1404 reference; browser code never generates geography identifiers.
Delivery uses only methods and fees returned by GET /shipping-methods; optional coupon is transported only into the authoritative Quote request.
Quote output is carried to Review only in an HttpOnly HMAC-bound snapshot tied to the server-only Checkout token. Client/browser storage is never authoritative for totals or credentials.
Reservation and Order submission use stable server-generated idempotency keys and fail closed on conflict, expiry or unknown outcomes.
New Address creation consumes the canonical source-locked Iran 1404 province/city reference merged by PR #310 and requires a valid province-city pair before calling the existing customer Address API.
Payment initiation/verify/status and Order Outcome runtime remain deferred placeholders for Stage 63-G; Stage F does not fabricate payment success.
Persian RTL, 44px targets, focus visibility and responsive reflow are present; credentials never enter URL, route data, browser storage or user-visible diagnostics.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, CodeQL Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact Human Gate, ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.
